title: Prototype HVA as the first workbook implementation
goal: Prototype Appendix A / HVA as the first implementation of Archivist's reusable workbook artifact family.
acceptance_criteria: Appendix A source evidence is summarized from the EPP Markdown artifact block and project metadata
The prototype preserves HVA hazard selection, scoring, prioritization, mitigation actions, annual review evidence, JSON import/export, and print intent
The design keeps the Markdown appendix wrapper and source/compliance traceability visible
Appendix J linkage is explicitly considered
The copyright guardrail against copying proprietary worksheet language, row order, layout, or comments is preserved
The prototype demonstrates the reusable workbook contract rather than hard-coding an Appendix A-only model
non_goals: Finalizing all Appendix A scoring policy
Replacing the old workbook renderer without a reviewed prototype
Expanding the HVA model beyond the existing EPP content evidence
validation: Confirm artifact metadata maps to docs/architecture/workbook-artifact-contract.md and workspaces/epp-full/project/artifact_index_seed.json
Run desktop-only app smoke after prototype implementation
notes: Appendix A is the most important current edge case because it is simultaneously Markdown, structured data, a guided local tool, a print/export packet, and a review-evidence source.
